integration_decision.checkpoint_meaning: The separate local review checkpoint preserves tested work; preservation does not promote production changes or authorize a merge to main.

integration_decision.wind_down: No further browser experiment is planned during wind-down. Retain the fixed cohort and all original failures; the separate own-read experiment remains separate.

isolated_candidate_changes: Logical mapped activations and guarded strict fresh-closure context inlining preserve actual callees, environments, full source positions and canonical recovery.
ARM64/x86-64 shared calls preserve the full call-site token; x86-64 includes pooled-frame direct calls and registered Windows unwind metadata.
Formal observer barriers, captured receiver/reference ownership, scalar compiler pooling and opt-in atomic shared-owner batches compose with selected native PCs and bounded operand borrowing.
isolated_candidate_defaults: In the isolated candidate, optimizing runtime policy, context inlining and shared owners remain opt-in. No threshold or compiler cap was raised. The candidate also changes default template/reflection and x86-64 direct-call implementation; none of this cumulative engine patch is promoted to main.
